import urllib.request, urllib.parse, re, html, json, ssl

UA = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36',
      'Accept-Language': 'en-US,en;q=0.9'}

def fetch(u):
    req = urllib.request.Request(u, headers=UA)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=25) as r:
        return r.status, r.read().decode('utf-8', 'ignore')

def clean(t):
    t = re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>', ' ', t, flags=re.S|re.I)
    t = re.sub(r'<style.*?</style>', ' ', t, flags=re.S|re.I)
    t = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', t)
    t = html.unescape(t)
    return re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', t).strip()

queries = [
    '"Duan Yihe" NUS',
    '"Duan Yihe" "Electrical and Computer Engineering"',
    'site:nus.edu.sg "Duan Yihe"',
    'site:comp.nus.edu.sg "Duan Yihe"',
    'site:ece.nus.edu.sg "Duan Yihe"',
    '"Yihe Duan" NUS',
    '"Duan Yihe" Singapore',
    '"Yihe Duan" electrical computer engineering',
]

engines = {
  'ddg': 'https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/?q={}',
  'bing': 'https://www.bing.com/search?q={}',
  'google': 'https://www.google.com/search?q={}&num=20',
}

for q in queries:
    for name, tmpl in engines.items():
        url = tmpl.format(urllib.parse.quote(q))
        try:
            st, body = fetch(url)
            txt = clean(body)
            # locate occurrences of key terms
            hits = []
            for m in re.finditer(r'(Duan Yihe|Yihe Duan)', txt, re.I):
                s = max(0, m.start()-300); e = min(len(txt), m.end()+400)
                hits.append(txt[s:e])
            print('=' * 100)
            print('QUERY', q, '| ENGINE', name, '| STATUS', st, '| LEN', len(body))
            seen = set()
            for h in hits[:6]:
                k = h[:120]
                if k in seen: continue
                seen.add(k)
                print('  ...', h)
        except Exception as e:
            print('ERR', q, name, repr(e))
